derivation: Experimenter-authored for EXP-2 phase 1 from repository structure only: Dokimos.sln, the ProjectReference graph (Domain <- Core <- Cli; each with a test project), the inputs named by the CI build-test-gate steps (quality gate policy and baselines, ratchet baseline and its rule catalog docs/quality/RATCHET-RULES.md, scripts/validate-package.sh, the results UI render), the site build's readJson inputs and site-gate composite action, and the push/paths filters of .github/workflows/*.yml. No CI outcome was consulted.
glob_semantics: Paths are repository-relative. '**' matches any sequence of characters including '/'; '*' matches any sequence without '/'; a pattern without a wildcard matches exactly that path.
select_when_semantics: Each select_when entry is a path-class id, or a glob when it is not a class id. 'always' selects the job on every push. A job with 'follows' is selected only when the named job is selected.
unmapped_policy_note: A changed path that matches no path class selects every job (conservative). Deletions and renames are evaluated on both old and new paths.

dotnet_closure.description: Inputs of `dotnet build/test Dokimos.sln`, package validation, the self-applied quality gate and ratchet in build-test-gate.

results_ui.description: Node inputs of the results-UI render steps inside build-test-gate and of the site gate.

action_install.description: Inputs of the action-install regression job.

site.description: Inputs of the site gate and site build: site sources, the results UI, the Node toolchain, CNAME, the readJson inputs (metric catalog, policy, accepted snapshot), Visual Engineering configuration, the gate action and the deploy workflow.

other_workflows.description: Definitions of workflows that are mandatory here or never run on push to main. Changing them selects nothing beyond the mandatory set.

governance_and_docs.description: Governance state and prose that no build, test or site step consumes. `praxis validate` and `praxis registry check` check them; that job is mandatory and always runs.

jobs.mandatory_reason: `praxis validate` and `praxis registry check` are the only RELEASE-GATES §2 carriers in Dokimos push CI: telemetry credential and secret-field rejection (§2.1), governance-state integrity (§2.4). Its debounce job is part of the same workflow and is selected with it.

jobs.note: A deployment. Its site gate repeats `praxis validate`, which the mandatory praxis-validation job carries.

unknown_job_policy: A historical job that matches no entry is treated as mandatory (always selected) and listed in the results.

checks.description: Check equivalence for cross-job detection: a failing step in a skipped job counts as detected at a commit when an executed job there fails at a step running the same check.
